advice: Treat all family members and close contacts at the same time. Wash clothes, bedsheets and towels in hot water and dry in sun; seal unwashable items in a bag for 3 days. Itching can continue for 2-4 weeks after cure.
name: Scabies

rx.sig: 200 mcg/kg single dose on day 1 and day 8 (not in pregnancy or child < 15 kg)

rx.instr: Apply from neck to toes at night, wash after 8-12 hours; repeat after 7 days
Apply on itchy areas twice daily
